zeroconf_confirm.title: Jung Home gateway discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Jung Home gateway was found at {host} (serial {serial}, firmware {version}). Choose how to connect.

menu_options.app_approval: Approve the connection in the Jung Home app
menu_options.password: Enter the gateway network-key password (connects instantly)

user.title: Connect to Jung Home
user.description: Your gateway is usually found automatically and shown on the Integrations page. If it was not, choose how to connect below.

menu_options.app_approval: Approve the connection in the Jung Home app
menu_options.password: Enter the gateway network-key password (connects instantly)

app_approval.title: Connect to Jung Home
app_approval.description: Confirm or enter the address of your Jung Home gateway. After you continue, approve the access request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway. It is filled in automatically when the gateway is discovered; otherwise the default junghome.local works on many networks, or use the IP address (for example 192.168.1.50).

password.title: Connect to Jung Home
password.description: Confirm the gateway address and enter its network-key password to connect immediately, without approving a request in the app. You can find the password in the Jung Home app.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway. It is filled in automatically when the gateway is discovered; otherwise the default junghome.local works on many networks, or use the IP address (for example 192.168.1.50).
data_description.password: The Jung Home gateway network-key password.

register_failed.title: Registration failed
register_failed.description: The access request was not approved in time or the gateway could not be reached. Submit to try again, then approve the request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize Jung Home
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway no longer accepts the stored access token. Approve the new access request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reauth_failed.title: Reauthorization failed
reauth_failed.description: The access request was not approved in time or the gateway could not be reached. Submit to try again, then approve the request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Jung Home
reconfigure.description: Update the address of your Jung Home gateway, for example after its IP address changed.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Jung Home gateway (for example 192.168.1.50 or junghome.local).

progress.waiting_for_approval: Approve the access request in the Jung Home app under Settings, Gateway, Access Permissions, Open Requests.

error.different_gateway: The address answers, but it belongs to a different Jung Home gateway than this entry.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the network-key password.
error.register_failed: Registration was not completed. Make sure you approve the request in the app.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress.
abort.already_configured: This Jung Home gateway is already configured.

init.title: Jung Home cover options
init.description: Select any covers whose position is reported inverted, such as awnings. Their position is flipped so fully closed reads as 0 percent (closed) and fully open as 100 percent (open). Leave roller shutters and blinds unselected.

abort.no_covers: No covers were found on this gateway, so there is nothing to configure.

auth_failed.message: The Jung Home gateway rejected the access token.

cannot_connect.message: Error communicating with the Jung Home gateway: {error}

cannot_send.message: Could not reach the Jung Home gateway to send the command; it is reconnecting. Try again in a moment.

command_timeout.message: The Jung Home gateway did not confirm the command in time.

invalid_response.message: The Jung Home gateway returned an unexpected response.

scene_not_found.message: The Jung Home scene {label} is no longer available on the gateway.

invalid_trigger.message: The Jung Home device does not support the trigger {trigger}.

websocket_push_failure.title: Jung Home live updates have stopped
websocket_push_failure.description: Home Assistant has failed to reconnect to the Jung Home gateway at {host} {failures} times in a row. Device states are no longer pushed instantly and now refresh only once a minute. Check that the gateway is powered on and reachable on your network. This issue disappears on its own once the connection is restored.
